 University of Florida freshman hit and killed crossing University Avenue, Gainesville officers say 
 A 19-year-old woman was hit and killed along West University Avenue Saturday night, Gainesville police officials said. By WCJB Staff Published : Oct. 25, 2026 at 11:17 PM EDT | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google GAINESVILLE, Fla. (WCJB) - Officers are investigating the death of a University of Florida student who was hit and killed while crossing West University Avenue on Saturday night.
 Gainesville Police Department officers have identified Hazel Krauss, 19, as the pedestrian killed near the university. UF officials confirm Krauss was a freshman in the Warrington College of Business. She’s originally from Chicago.
 Officers say a driver heading eastbound swerved to avoid another vehicle and hit the woman as she crossed the street, as well as the other vehicle. 
 A nurse on the scene helped the woman until rescue crews arrived. Krauss was taken to the hospital, where she died.
 No arrests have been made.
 This is a developing story.
